question_text: Under Article VI of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following correctly states the qualifications and term of office for a Senator of the Philippines?

options.text: At least 35 years old, a natural-born citizen, able to read and write, and serves a term of six years with a maximum of two consecutive terms.
At least 30 years old, a natural-born citizen, able to read and write, and serves a term of six years with a maximum of two consecutive terms.
At least 35 years old, a naturalized citizen, able to read and write, and serves a term of six years with no term limit.
At least 30 years old, a natural-born citizen, able to read and write, and serves a term of four years with a maximum of three consecutive terms.
